correct_statement: NO NEW CONFIRMATORY SIGNIFICANCE PROCEDURE IS ELIGIBLE.
primary_decision_rule: PRESERVATION_ASSERTED iff macro lower 95% percentile-CI bound > -0.005 (strict)
p_value_role: secondary/descriptive only for the primary preservation claim
per_domain_harm_rule: A domain is HARM if its own 95% CI upper bound is below 0; preservation cannot be claimed while any domain CI indicates harm.
ci_method: percentile bootstrap (frozen plan); domain-stratified group bootstrap where previously frozen (B=2000, seed=42)
paired_analysis_unit: sample (per-domain group cluster for domain-stratified bootstrap)
allowed_wording_nonsignificant: descriptive only; report the estimate with its frozen CI and label it descriptive
